name: a guard lists registers and guards each at its stored stamp
a written field left unlisted gets no guard
a listed register that is unset guards with a null stamp
a guard on a created record's register is null
guards may name registers the gesture only read, from stored
a guard reads stored: a ready write counts, a held one does not
per-record intents carry their own records' guards; a guard on a record no delta writes goes with the first intent
a guarded update that changes nothing enqueues nothing, held or not, and writes no notice: its guards go with no intent
an unguarded update beside a guarded register of another record, in one intent
